messages:
noah: Heads-up - customer reported service-account rotation caused requests to flip billing from their sandbox project to a legacy prod project. Noted in quota spikes.
sana: Is this with short-lived impersonation tokens or long-lived keys?
noah: Short-lived, minted by our token-exchange service. Logs show original token had project=proj-sandbox but inspected token after rotate had proj-legacy.
devon: Routing currently trusts the token's embedded project claim at issuance time. If rotation issues a new token without copy of original_project, we lose affinity.
claire: Proposal: token-exchange must copy `orig_project` into token metadata and emit `x-routing-reason=rotated` trace tag. Also add `billing_affinity` field so exports can choose which project to bill.
sana: We should avoid changing billing shape without finance signoff. Suggest dark-launch: add metadata but keep billing behavior unchanged for 7 days. Then roll to use `billing_affinity` if no objections.
devon: I'll add tests: (1) ensure exchange preserves orig_project, (2) ensure routing falls back to orig_project when rotated_token missing claim, behind FF.
claire: Console UX: surface a small "rotated token detected" badge on project usage rows and a filter for "rotation-affinity" so infra/support can triage.
infra-bot: [automated] Created ticket INF-5010: "token-exchange preserve orig_project + telemetry" assigned to devon.
noah: Owners: devon -> middleware/PR, sana -> rollout coordination + finance, claire -> console filter mock. Sync tomorrow 11am to review PR.
noah: quick note - consider rate-limit semantics: key-level limits must still apply even if billing_affinity differs. Don't want rotated tokens bypassing key quotas.
devon: Agreed, rate-limits apply at token-id before billing attribution. We'll document.
noah: thanks, see you at sync. :thumbsup:
